unit.why: A minimal narrative frame: R. Aharon of Karlin dies and his disciple R. Shlomo of Karlin eulogizes him. Almost all of the content is the eulogy's homily on Rashi's reading of Enoch, so this is a borderline case close to saying_or_teaching.
unit.boundary_note: The previous division ends with the catchword 'כשנסתלק', which opens this division's text. This division is self-contained.

stories.start_quote: מהה"ק ר׳ אהרן מקארלין ז"ל כשנסתלק
stories.end_quote: כי נסתלק כשהיה בן ל"ה שנים זי״ע
stories.summary_en: At the death of R. Aharon of Karlin, his disciple R. Shlomo eulogizes him. He reinterprets Rashi on Enoch: Enoch was taken early because even his mundane speech moved people to repentance and would have hastened the final 'birur' before its time. R. Aharon was of the same rank and so died at 35.

tags.why: The text is mainly an exegetical homily inside a thin narrative frame.
